dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 27, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Power Hitters Shine in Saturday's Action**

In a day filled with big hits and dominant pitching, several players made their mark on the scoreboard. Miami's Kazuma Okamoto hit his 11th home run of the season, a fly ball to right center field, in a 1-2 loss to Toronto. Meanwhile, Seattle's Rob Refsnyder went deep for the third time in his last four games, contributing to a 9-1 win over Oakland.

On the mound, St. Louis' Dustin May threw seven scoreless innings, striking out nine in a 1-2 loss to Milwaukee. The Brewers' Aaron Ashby earned the win, while the Cardinals' Dustin May took the loss. Elsewhere, Arizona's Trevor McDonald tossed 6.1 innings, fanning six in a 3-2 victory over San Francisco.

Other notable performances came from Philadelphia's Trea Turner, who homered for the seventh time this season in a 3-0 win over San Diego. Baltimore's Blaze Alexander had a huge day, going 3-for-4 with a home run and six RBIs in an 11-2 rout of Tampa Bay.
